e: A historic meeting of the leaders of the four constituent members of the Realm of New Zealand to discuss constitutional arrangements is held in Auckland. This meeting is attended by Ulu-o-Tokelau Alapati Tavite, New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon, Niue Prime Minister Dalton Tagelagi, and Cook Islands Prime Minister Mark Brown.
Governor-General of New Zealand Cindy Kiro and HMNZS Canterbury visit Tokelau to meet with local leaders.
The 2026 Tokelauan general election is held. Results are released on 7 February.
The New Zealand Government confirms that it has cancelled plans to build an airport in Tokelau, citing high costs and the adverse environmental impact.
